Theme

Household, washing & chores · Nature & food

transplant verb

also replant, plant out, move a plant, pot on

classical

Varr. RR 1.39.3: sēmina, quae trānsferuntur ē terrā in terram (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 13.37: plantāria īnstituunt anniculāsque trānsferunt (Lewis & Short)

trānsferō, trānsferre, trānstulī, trānslātum

verb, conjugation

move (a plant) to another place, transplant

The gardeners’ use of the ordinary verb for carrying across; also of transferring by grafting (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • sēmina, quae trānsferuntur ē terrā in terram

    seedlings that are moved from one soil to anotherVarr. RR 1.39.3 (Lewis & Short)

See also nursery, sow, dig, transfer.

SourcesLewis & Short: transfero · Lewis & Short: plantarium
